actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Welcome to Amazon Safe to Go training module. In this module, you will learn how to perform LOTO on a conveyor belt safely.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Working near a telescopic conveyor exposes you to moving parts, dock traffic, and pinch points. Your protective equipment is your first line of defence.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up the reflective jacket, safety boots, and gloves to put them on.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Put on the reflective jacket, safety boots, and gloves before entering the work area.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Your PPE is laid in front of you. Grab each item and place it on your body.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You are ready to step on the shop floor. Let us go!","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Conveyor injuries can happen in seconds when a machine has not been isolated. Observe what happens next.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"There was a blockage on the conveyor, to clear it the worker climbs onto the belt to clear it manually.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"This was dangerous and an unsafe practice. You should always apply the emergency stop button before doing any maintenance work. There are sensors on the conveyor belt. During blockage, they automatically stop the belt movement but as soon as the blockage is cleared, it starts running the belt. Hence you should never stop on the conveyor belt without proper isolation.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"If you spot anything dangerous, immediately press the nearest emergency stop button to prevent injury to anyone near the belt.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Locate the emergency button near you and press it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Press the emergency stop button to halt the conveyor.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The red emergency stop button is in front of you. Press it to stop the conveyor.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"This conveyor was repaired with its bottom guard removed. To test the repair, the team ran it without refitting the guard or reapplying LOTO.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The injured worker needs help immediately. Use the walkie-talkie to call for medical assistance.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"There is a medical emergency. We need immediate medical assistance.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the walkie-talkie to call for medical assistance.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The walkie-talkie is highlighted. Grab it and use it to request medical help.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"This is the emergency medical service, we are on our way to help.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: ChecklistUIToggle
actions.Data: {"titleText":"Pre-Isolation Preparation","toggleInfos":["Collect Permit to Work","Notify Affected Associates","Review LOTO Placard","Extend Conveyor"],"waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Every LOTO task begins with a plan. The Permit to Work records the task and every energy source that must be isolated before work starts.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the Permit to Work before starting the isolation.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The Permit to Work is at the station in front of you. Grab it to continue.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Everyone working in this area must know that isolation is about to begin, so no one attempts to start the conveyor.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Isolation is about to begin. Do not start or operate the conveyor","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the walkie-talkie to notify the team.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The walkie-talkie is beside you. Use it to inform everyone that isolation work is starting.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The LOTO placard on this conveyor lists every isolation point and energy type. You must review it before any isolation begins.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Touch the LOTO placard to acknowledge the isolation points.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The placard is mounted on the conveyor body in front of you. Touch it to continue.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"As per amazon's LOTO policy, each LOTO lock has only one key. So, if I’ve placed the LOTO lock, the key stays with me. There’s no group isolation box involved.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The conveyor cannot be repositioned once its power is isolated. It must be placed in the extended position first.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Press the Extend button until the conveyor is fully extended.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Press the Extend button to move the conveyor into the extended position.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The Extend button is on the control panel in front of you. Press it until the conveyor stops extending.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: ChecklistUIToggle
actions.Data: {"titleText":"Energy Isolation","toggleInfos":["Isolate E-1 Breaker","Lockout E-1 Breaker","Isolate E-2 Breaker","Lockout E-2 Breaker","Apply Padlock","Isolate EMP-1 Breaker","Lockout EMP-1 Breaker","Begin Maintenance Work","Dos and Donâ€™ts"],"waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The E-1 breaker supplies 415 volts to the telescopic conveyor. Switching it off is the first isolation point as per the S O P. The E-1 breaker is situated on an electrical panel on the conveyor belt itself.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Rotate the E-1 breaker to the Off position.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Rotate the E-1 breaker handle to the Off position.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The E-1 breaker is on the front of the control panel. Grab the handle and turn it to OFF.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"A breaker that is only switched off can be turned back on by anyone. A padlock keeps E-1 isolated until your work is complete.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the padlock and apply it to the E-1 breaker.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up the padlock and apply it to the E-1 breaker.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The padlock is infront of you. Place it on the E-1 lockout point to secure the breaker.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You’ve isolated the first point of the telescopic conveyor. Every telescopic conveyor is connected to the D B. Our next point of  isolation is there. Let’s go.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The E-2 breaker, carries the 230-volt U P S supply to the conveyor. It can keep circuits live even after E-1 is off. You need to identify the E-2 breaker for the telescopic conveyor you need to isolate.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"I have identified the E-2 breaker for you. Now, pull down the E-2 breaker to the Off position.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pull the E-2 breaker down to the Off position.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"E-2 is inside the control panel. Pull it down to OFF to isolate the U P S supply.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"A miniature circuit breaker is too small for a standard padlock. A circuit breaker lockout device holds it in the OFF position so it cannot be re-energized.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the lockout device and apply it to the E-2 breaker.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up the lockout device and fit it onto the E-2 breaker.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The lockout device is infront of you. Place it on the breaker to lock in the Off position.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"This screw helps tighten the lockout device to the breaker switch. Let me do it for you.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now, grab the padlock and apply it to lockout the E-2 breaker.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up the padlock and apply it to the E-2 breaker.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The padlock is infront of you. Place it on the E-2 lockout point to secure the breaker.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"EMP-1 is the 415-volt main power supply to the telescopic conveyor. It is the final electrical isolation point.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Turn the EMP-1 breaker to the OFF position.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Turn the EMP-1 breaker to the OFF position.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"EMP-1 is in front of you. Grab the knob and turn it to OFF.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Apply the padlock lockout device to the EMP-1 breaker to secure it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the padlock for performing lockout of the EMP-1 breaker.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The padlock is in front of you. Attach the padlock to the breaker.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Every energy source has been isolated, and locked out. The conveyor is now safe for maintenance.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the bottom guard and pull it open to begin maintenance.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The bottom guard is in front of you. Grab its handle and open it.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let's review what you've learned. Grab each card, read it, and drop it in the correct bin — green for Do's, red for Don'ts.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Great job! You have learnt how to safely isolate and perform loto for a telescopic conveyor.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}
